analyst.summary: Manorama Industries makes specialty cocoa-butter-substitute fats and butters for global chocolate and cosmetics companies, and has posted explosive recent growth (revenue +117%, profit +273% in the last confirmed quarter) alongside high returns on capital (ROE ~28%). A 30% capacity expansion coming online and new African shea-sourcing subsidiaries support continued strong growth, though the current triple-digit pace partly reflects the company's still-small base and should not be extrapolated forward at face value. At ~42x earnings we rate it a Hold.
